author: Mark Atwood
text:
Cannot apply as-written: let-chains in if/while conditions require Rust edition 2024, not just MSRV 1.88. Workspace is on edition 2021 (Cargo.toml:39).

Subagent confirmed by compile attempt: 12 binary refactors applied to space.rs produced 12 instances of 'error: let chains are only allowed in Rust 2024 or later'. Reverted cleanly; tree was clean before commit.

Pattern confirmation (before revert):
- space.rs: 12 sites at lines 271, 292, 300, 328, 354, 362, 401, 425, 433, 463, 487, 495
- chat.rs: 3 sites at lines 307, 323, 331
- message.rs: triple at 190-201

All matched the bead's expected shape. The bead's correctness analysis is solid; only the edition gating was missed.

Blocked on bd:JMAP-i3cz (workspace edition bump to 2024). After that lands, this bead can be re-opened and the refactor applied mechanically (subagent already verified the edit shape works syntactically when the constraint is removed).
